note: The roughly 10-year fixed-rate tranche of each issuer's most recent USD senior deal, read from its own filing. Microsoft has issued no new-money USD bonds since January 2017 (its 3.300% notes due 2027 priced at +85bp then), so it is left out of the comparison. CoreWeave also borrows through secured delayed-draw term loans backed by GPUs and customer contracts, at SOFR + 2.25% to 5.50% (2026 8-Ks); Nebius has issued only convertible bonds, plus a secured term loan at SOFR + 2.50%. Loans are a different instrument and are not shown as rows.
